cell_line.evidence: Adherent HEK293 cells (WT from ATCC: CRL-1573) were grown in DMEM/F-12 (1:1 v/v) (Gibco) supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated fetal bovine serum (Sigma-Aldrich) and 2 mM GlutaMAX (Gibco) at 37 °C and 5% CO2.

Suspension CHO cells (WT from Sigma-Aldrich no. 85050302) were cultured in EX-CELL CHO CD Fusion serum-free media (Sigma) and BalanCD CHO Growth A media (FUJIFILM) (1:1 v/v) supplemented with 4 mM GlutaMAX (Gibco).
HepG2 cells were cultured in DMEM media (Gibco) supplemented with 10% FBS, 1% glutamine, and 1% non-essential amino acids solution (Gibco).
